conviction_note: Zero because the event is not in the window. Neither the sealed bmo window (close 09-23 to close 09-24) nor the resolver's alternative amc window (close 09-24 to close 09-25) contains the print.

outside_window.finding: Alten reports H1 2026 results on Friday 2026-09-25 after the close (about 17:40 Paris), so the first session that can react is 2026-09-28. H1 revenue is already public, so the surprise can only come from the H1 operating margin against the ~9% FY guide, or from any further change to the guide. The stock's reaction on guidance is large: +18.9% intraday on 2026-07-29 after the guide was raised. I found no evidence on the direction of the margin, so this is unsized.

searched_and_found_nothing: alten.com investor pages (https://www.alten.com/investors/, /calendar/, /fr/investisseurs/, /feed/, wp-json) return 403 to both curl and WebFetch, so the company's own agenda page could not be read. The date comes from the company's AMF-filed release instead.

WebSearch summaries gave three different dates for the H1 results (September 24 17:40, September 25, October 27), and none of them came with a readable underlying page. They are treated as unreliable and nothing rests on them. Oct 27 is the Q3 revenue date on the ABC Bourse calendar.
AMF flux (info-financiere.gouv.fr): no Alten filing after 2026-09-16 (a weekly buyback report). No date change, no information privilégiée, no profit warning ahead of the print.
Les Echos, Investir, Boursier.com, Zonebourse, actusnews: known to be shut (403), not retried.

The opendatasoft FTP mirror served an unrelated issuer's (Adocia) PDF for two Alten URLs (FCECO082754_20260728.pdf and FCECO079759_20250925.pdf). The FR H1 2026 PDF (FCECO082752) read correctly, and the webdisclosure copies were used as the text source for the rest.
baseline_tension: Nothing to set against the lean (+0.60) or the run-up (-4.75% over 20 days, +28.73% over 60 days, the 60-day figure mostly the +18.9% guide-raise gap on 2026-07-29): the print falls outside the window, so this hunt has no view on the 09-23 to 09-24 session.
language_note: The French-language sources are what settled the date. The AMF-filed release (FR and EN both say 25 September) and the French ABC Bourse calendar and 'J-2' item both put the print on 2026-09-25, against the vendor's 2026-09-24. English WebSearch summaries contradicted each other (24 Sept, 25 Sept, 27 Oct) and could not be checked because alten.com returns 403.

ABC Bourse's French calendar marks the H1 results after the close ('Après clôture' for 25/09/2025), which confirms the amc pattern the AMF timestamps show. No English source reached from here carried the session.
